hook: Their boat was sinking. The jetty was all they had.
narration: Their boat began taking on water in the Coquille River in Oregon, and two people ended up stranded on the rocks of the South Jetty.
A Dolphin helicopter crew from Coast Guard Air Station North Bend came in over the jetty.
Jetties are hard places to reach. Waves surge between the rocks, so a boat cannot safely pull alongside.
From the air, the crew can lower a basket straight down to the people on the rocks.
outcome: The North Bend crew hoisted both people off the jetty rocks.
title: Their boat sank and the jetty rocks were all they had
description:
Two people were stranded on the rocks of the South Jetty in Oregon's Coquille River after their boat began taking on water on Aug. 3, 2026. An MH-65 Dolphin crew from Coast Guard Air Station North Bend hoisted them off the rocks.
